label: <DEL> step of length-9 sequences (sparse, content-gated subset)
explanation: Fires only at the delimiter step: 100% of dev activation mass is at phase 1, and 99% of it is at L=9 (t=9, to_go=8). A handful of activations come from L=8 and one from L=3. It never fires during the original or copy phases. But it fires on only about 2% of L=9 delimiter steps, so the predicate has about 0.98 recall and only about 0.02 precision. Which L=9 sequences fire depends on the sequence content in a distributed way. It is enriched when the first token (also the next output) is b, 3, h, z or j, when the preceding token is g, p or y, and when the token after that is e, z, h or f. Lookup lists built from these lifts reach only about 0.19 F1, so the gating was not captured. Magnitude is small (max 0.017) and was not checked against any variable beyond these lifts.
